7: remove an arbitrary set of \( x_r^i \) red and \( x_b^i \) blue points from \( T(v_i) \) and add them to \( P_v \)  
8: end for  
9: output an \( (r, b) \)-fairlet decomposition of \( P_v \)  
{Step 3: proceed to the children of \( v \)}

1: for all fairlet \(q_{i}\in Q\) do   
2: let an arbitrary point \(c_{i}\in q_{i}\) be the center of \(q_{i}\)   
3: add \(|q_i|\) copies of \(c_{i}\) to \(\overline{P}\)   
4: end for   
5: \(\mathcal{C}:= \{C_1,\dots ,C_k\} \gets \beta\) -approximate \(k\) -median clustering of \(\overline{P}\)   
6: \(\mathcal{C}^* \gets \{\bigcup_{j:c_j\in C_i}q_j\}_{i = 1}^k\) {each fairlet joins the cluster of its center in \(\mathcal{C}\)}   
7: return \(\mathcal{C}^*\)

{Stage 1: lower bound on the number of heavy points}   
1: for all non-empty children \(i\in [\gamma^d ]\) of \(\mathcal{V}\) do   
2: \((x_r^i,x_b^i)\gets \mathrm{UNBALANCEDPOINTS}(N_r^i,N_b^i,r,b)\)   
3: end for   
4: \(y_{r}\gets \sum_{i\in [\gamma^{d}]}x_{r}^{i},y_{b}\gets \sum_{i\in [\gamma^{d}]}x_{b}^{i}\)   
5: \(c_{\mathrm{dom}}\gets \mathrm{argmax}_{c\in \{r,b\}}y_c,\overline{c_{\mathrm{dom}}}\gets \{r,b\} \setminus c_{\mathrm{dom}}\) {Stage 2: add free points with color \(\overline{c_{\mathrm{dom}}}\)   
6: if \((\sum_{i\in [\gamma^d ]}x_r^i,\sum_{i\in [\gamma^d ]}x_b^i)\) is \((r,b)\) -balanced then   
7: break   
8: end if   
9: for all non-empty children \(i\in [\gamma^d ]\) of \(\mathcal{V}\) do   
10: \(x_{\overline{c_{\mathrm{dom}}}}^{i}\gets x_{\overline{c_{\mathrm{dom}}}}^{i} + \max (\mathrm{EXTRAPoint}(\overline{c_{\mathrm{dom}}},N_r^i -x_r^i,N_b^i -x_b^i,r,b),y_{c_{\mathrm{dom}}} - y_{\overline{c_{\mathrm{dom}}}})\)   
11: end for   
{Stage 3: add points of non-saturated \((r,b)\) -fairlets}   
12: if \((\sum_{i\in [\gamma^d ]}x_r^i,\sum_{i\in [\gamma^d ]}x_b^i)\) is \((r,b)\) -balanced then   
13: break   
14: end if   
15: for all non-empty children \(i\in [\gamma^d ]\) of \(\mathcal{V}\) do   
16: \((n_r,n_b)\gets \mathrm{NONSATURFAIRLET}(N_r^i -x_r^i,N_b^i -x_b^i,r,b)\)   
17: \(x_r^i\gets x_r^i +n_r,x_b^i\gets x_b^i +n_b\)   
18: end for   
19: return \((\{x_r^i,x_b^i\}_{i\in [\gamma^d ]})\)

4: return \((0, N_{b} - \lfloor N_{r} \cdot \frac{r}{b} \rfloor)\)

1: if \(N_{c} \leq N_{\overline{c}}\) then  
2: return 0  
3: end if  
4: return \(\lceil N_{\overline{c}} \cdot \frac{b}{r} \rceil\)
